## isva-p02-v18 — argument map

**Speaker.** Utpaladeva (siddhāntin)

**Question.** Does imagined spread order all?

**Premises.**
- There (tatra), if (yadi) the conscious one's spread (prasaraḥ) by name (nāma) be imagined (kalpyate).
- Not (na) by that much alone (tāvataiva) does order (vyavasthā) hold everywhere (sarvatra) — thus (tathā ghaṭate).

**Inference.** Imagined spread of the conscious doesn't alone order everywhere.
